mapper.sql: id, content_id, channel, app_id, media_id, publish_id, article_id, article_url, thumb_media_id, status, error_msg, published_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_marketing_content_publish WHERE content_id = #{contentId}::uuid ORDER BY update_time DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_marketing_content_publish ( id, content_id, channel, app_id, media_id, publish_id, article_id, article_url, thumb_media_id, status, error_msg, published_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{contentId}::uuid, COALESCE(#{channel}, 'wechat_mp'), #{appId}, #{mediaId}, #{publishId}, #{articleId}, #{articleUrl}, #{thumbMediaId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'synced'), #{errorMsg}, #{publishedAt}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, now()) )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_marketing_content_publish SET media_id = #{mediaId}, publish_id = #{publishId}, article_id = #{articleId}, article_url = #{articleUrl}, thumb_media_id = #{thumbMediaId}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, update_time = COALESCE(#{updateTime}, now()) WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
